name: upgrade-owned-scaffold-scope
body: The refresh set is exactly the kalide-owned scaffold content scoped to the project's form: (a) a deck-root author-guide pair — the full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` (agent-authoring) plus its `AGENTS.md` pointer (agent-guide-reference) — and, for a no-arg seed deck only, the `kalide init` seed starter content (cli-init-minimal-seed: the seed `templates/library.yaml`, the `hello` slide template `templates/slides/hello/*`, the seed default theme `templates/themes/default/theme.css`, and `slides/1-hello.md`); (b) a library-root author-guide pair (library-agent-guide plus its pointer) and, only when it is the seeded default, `themes/default/theme.css` (init-library). A refresh member is the full guides `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` and the seed starter content, and the byte-identical rule covers only those: each is written only while it is present and byte-identical to a known released kalide version, except the full guides `AGENTS_KALIDE.md`, which are also written when absent. The `AGENTS.md` pointer is never refreshed by a byte-identical whole-file rewrite, and follows only the agent-guide-reference scheme: it is created carrying the embedded pointer content (agent-guide-reference) when absent, migrated when it is a known released full guide, left untouched when it already carries the reference string, and otherwise appended to with the reference line. A seed starter file that is absent — because the author deleted it after init — is never re-created. A no-arg seed deck is exactly a deck whose `kalide.yaml` has no non-empty `templates:` key and whose local `templates/` directory exists; a non-empty `templates:` key makes it an external-library deck, and a local `templates/` directory in such a deck is a library layer loaded alongside the external library into the deck's one library (layered-template-library), author content outside this scoped set. Only a no-arg seed deck can own the seed tree; the seed-owned paths are `templates/library.yaml`, `templates/slides/hello/*`, `templates/themes/default/theme.css` and `slides/1-hello.md`. The set never includes author slides/sections/templates/themes/media, never an external-library deck's local `templates/` layer, and never a library's templates. `kalide.yaml` is the author-edited deck config and is not a whole-file refresh member. A file outside this scoped set is never written, whatever its contents.
